summary: An SAP Community blog post by SAP Commerce Cloud team (posted 06-15-2023 by PhilippeS) urging customers to upgrade to Composable Storefront 6 or later and Node.js 18 to stay current and avoid build errors. It explains that third-party dependencies with high-severity security issues (CVSS 7 or higher) in end-of-life versions such as Node.js 14 can lead to withdrawn support on short notice, and that non-current versions will fail builds from 2024 onward. It also points to SAP's release policy, dependency matrix and terms for further details.
one_line: SAP blog urging customers to upgrade to Composable Storefront 6 or later and Node.js 18 to avoid build errors and lost support.
key_facts: The SAP Commerce Cloud team blog post 'Staying current with Commerce Cloud and Composable Storefront' was posted on 06-15-2023 by PhilippeS.
The post urges customers to upgrade to Composable Storefront 6 (or later) and/or Node.js 18 now.
Versions of Composable Storefront that are not current will result in build errors, and new code cannot be deployed.
Composable Storefront / Spartacus depends on third-party libraries.
If a high security issue is found in end-of-life third-party dependencies such as Node.js 14, support will be withdrawn from Commerce Cloud with short notice (1-2 weeks).
A 'high security issue' is defined as a vulnerability with a CVSSv3 score of 7 or higher.
The enforcement of current versions applies starting in 2024 or upon the event described above, whichever comes first.
According to the SAP Commerce Cloud Supplemental Terms and Conditions, customers must run a current version of SAP Commerce Cloud.
The customer organization is responsible for installing new releases and upgrading SAP Commerce Cloud software.
The Update Release Policy and Publication Frequency for Composable Storefront Libraries describes which Composable Storefront versions are current and which Commerce Cloud backends are supported.
The Composable Storefront Dependencies Matrix shows which Composable Storefront updates work with which versions of Node.js and Angular.
The post is tagged with Product Updates, angular, composable storefront, Spartacus, and SAP managed tags Digital Technologies, Node.js and SAP Commerce Cloud.
Questions should be directed to the customer's account team.
